resources.string: Heartbeat
Every 15 minutes: agent state (battery, pending events, lost events, active collectors, last upload, Device Owner mode).
Device

Screen on, off or unlocked; battery; power saving; boot and shutdown; inventory (model, Android and One UI version, security patch, verified boot state); free storage; time and time zone changes; airplane mode; thermal state.
Location

GPS positions and positions obtained passively by other apps; by default without any Google service (the "GPS + network" and "fused" modes, selectable below, go through Google Play services). Fast cadence while moving, slowed down when stationary. Reports mock locations and the enabling or disabling of location providers.
No GPS receiver on this device
GPS interval while moving
Delay between two GPS positions when the device is moving.
GPS interval while stationary
Delay between two GPS positions when the device is still (saves battery).
Passive positions
Also record the positions requested by other apps (no energy cost).
Minimum interval of passive positions
Usage access not granted: Settings › Apps › Special access › Usage data access › Watchpost, or scripts/grant-adb-permissions.sh
Connectivity

Default network on every change: Wi-Fi, mobile, VPN or Ethernet, validated Internet access, metered network, private DNS active and its server, DNS servers, interface. System callback, no periodic polling; at most 60 events per hour.
Wi-Fi

Wi-Fi connections and disconnections: network name (SSID), access point (BSSID), signal, frequency, security and standard. The name and the access point require precise location (otherwise they are omitted). System callback, no scanning; a few events per day.
Neighbouring Wi-Fi networks

Optional: list of the Wi-Fi networks visible around the device (names and access points of third parties). By default, only picks up the scans already done by the system, with no radio cost; at most one event every 15 minutes. Active scanning is possible (at most every 30 minutes, limited by Android).
Minimum interval between two readings
Results that arrive closer together are ignored.
Active scanning
0 = never (passive listening only). Otherwise, interval in minutes (30 at least).
Mobile hotspot
Enabling and disabling of Wi-Fi tethering (hotspot). System broadcast, no cost.
NFC
Enabling and disabling of NFC. System broadcast, no cost.
No NFC on this device
Network volumes per app

Every hour: bytes received and sent per app, over Wi-Fi and mobile data (system statistics). Requires usage access or Device Owner mode. The system counts in buckets of about 2 h: the hourly breakdown is an estimate. One query per hour.
Mobile network

Serving cell on every change: technology (2G to 5G), operator, country and network, area, cell identifier, band, signal, roaming. Alert if the device drops to 2G (a network without mutual authentication, used by fake base stations). Cell identifiers require precise location (and the "Phone" permission to follow every cell change and the signal). System callback, at most one event every 20 seconds. Not detectable without system privilege: null encryption, identifier requests.
Bluetooth

Enabling and disabling of Bluetooth; device connections and disconnections (name, address, type) if the "Nearby devices" permission is granted. System broadcasts, no scanning; at most 120 events per hour.
Trackers following you

Detects a tracker (AirTag, SmartTag, Tile, Google Find My Device) away from its owner and seen several times while the device moves. Low-power Bluetooth scan filtered by the hardware on these trackers only, positions taken from the passive cache (no GPS request). Bluetooth on only. Low but continuous cost.
Minimum follow duration
Time between the first and the last sighting before the alert.
Minimum movement
Distance travelled by the device while the tracker is seen.
Apps

Full inventory of the apps every day and after every boot (version, install source, signature, sensitive permissions granted, enabled, suspended or hidden state); installs, updates and uninstalls as soon as they happen; permissions granted or withdrawn (hourly comparison). One package walk per hour.
Foreground app

App that comes to the foreground or leaves it (app changes only). Requires usage access. Polled every minute with the screen on only; each event carries the time given by the system (not that of the poll). A few hundred events per day.
Special access

Every day and on every change: active accessibility services, notification listeners, device administrators, apps allowed to draw over other apps, to install apps, to read usage statistics, apps offering a VPN, default apps (browser, home, phone, SMS, keyboard, assistant, autofill). What the system refuses to tell is omitted. Checked after an app or setting change and at most every 15 minutes when the screen turns off.
Camera
Opening and closing of a camera by any app, with the screen and lock state. Android does not say which app (except through experimental attribution). System callback, no cost.
Microphone

Start and end of an audio recording by any app (audio source, recording silenced by the system), with the screen and lock state. Android does not say which app (except through experimental attribution). System callback, no cost.
Experimental attribution (DUMP)
Looks for the responsible app in the system app-ops state. Requires the DUMP permission granted through ADB; format not guaranteed, may stop working after an update.
USB

USB cable plugged or unplugged, configuration and active functions (file transfer, tethering, MIDI, ADB debugging…), USB devices and accessories plugged into the phone (manufacturer, product). System broadcasts, no cost.
Notifications

Which apps display notifications: app, category, channel, importance, ongoing notification or not, display and removal. Read by the separate, optional "Watchpost Notifications" companion (this APK never reads notifications). Title and text only if "Notification content" is enabled, with 4 to 8 digit codes masked; known banking, authentication, password manager, SMS and phone apps are excluded (list by package name, therefore incomplete, adjustable in the companion). Repeated updates and ongoing notifications are not forwarded; at most 20 events per app per 10 minutes, often a few dozen per day.
Notification content
Also forward the title and the text (512 characters at most). These are third-party messages: disabled by default. When disabled, they never leave the companion.
Mask numeric codes
Replaces any run of 4 to 8 digits with •••• (validation codes received by SMS or by app). Also masks years, round amounts or postal codes; does not see alphanumeric codes.
The "Watchpost Notifications" companion is not installed (separate, optional APK: scripts/install-notifier.sh, see the README).
The "Watchpost Notifications" companion is not signed with the same key as Watchpost: install the one from the same build (same keystore).
The "Watchpost Notifications" companion does not have notification access: scripts/notifier-access.sh, or open the companion and follow its instructions.
Watchpost notification local relay
Channel between Watchpost and its notifications companion, reserved for apps signed with the same key.
